description: r.side's task has a budget deadline of 100 ns and sleeps 200 ns, with no checkpoint to acknowledge the deadline: its record stays Running and the body's return completes it Ok (its join reports Cancelled(Deadline), the snapshot). The region's close outcome folds the record's outcome, so the driver reads Ok at 400 after the driver finished the region with an ok body at 350. t.m in r.main only keeps the clock moving.
